name: 被动语态频率
description: 分析 the ratio and 分布 of 被动语态 constructions, 其 AI text tends to overuse compared to 人类写作.
useCase: 检测AI生成文本 through systematic overuse of 被动语态 constructions
mechanism: 识别 被动语态 constructions 通过分析 auxiliary verb + past participle 模式 and dependency parse structures. Computes the passive-to-active ratio per paragraph and its 方差. AI生成的 text, particularly from instruction-tuned models, tends to use 被动语态 more uniformly than humans, who naturally vary voice usage based on emphasis, stylistic preference, and information structure.
accuracy: 低-中 - 65-75% as standalone 特征
source: Herbold, S. et al. (2023) - A Large-Scale Comparison of Human-Written Versus ChatGPT-Generated Essays, Scientific Reports
algorithm: Dependency Parse Voice Detection + Ratio Analysis + Variance Measurement
parameters: Detection method: dependency parse 模式, Granularity: per-paragraph, Metrics: passive ratio, passive 方差, passive clustering
strengths:
• Captures a known stylistic bias of AI systems
• Easy to compute and interpret
• Works well as part of 特征 ensemble
• Consistent signal 跨 AI models
limitations:
• Low standalone discriminative power
• Academic and scientific text naturally uses 被动语态
• Modern LLMs can be prompted to avoid 被动语态
• Language-specific (mainly English)

references.title: Herbold, S. et al. (2023). A Large-Scale Comparison of Human-Written Versus ChatGPT-Generated Essays. Scientific Reports.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
Biber, D. (1988). Variation Across Speech and Writing. Cambridge University Press.
